label: Thermal gradient and gas-water interface chambers
description: Records the geometry, gradient and flow settings of microfluidic chambers with a thermal gradient or gas-water interface, and their accumulation results. Applies to thermophoresis, heat-flow and evaporation-interface studies of prebiotic accumulation.
covers: Warm and cold side temperatures, temperature difference, chamber thickness, liquid and gas flow rates, flow velocity, accumulation factor and Soret coefficient.

variable_categories.label: Thermal gradient chamber
variable_categories.description: Gradient, geometry, flow and accumulation values of thermal-gradient and gas-interface chambers.
